- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh | The REST fallback block in recover_stalled_issue that calls _reconcile_merged_pr_issue after fetching _lpr_json via REST (third merged-PR guard, lines ~17713-17744 in the diff) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The REST fallback fetches the full PR payload into _lpr_json, then calls _reconcile_merged_pr_issue with only _mgd_issue_json as the optional fifth argument. _reconcile_merged_pr_issue does not accept a known PR JSON as a sixth argument, so it calls _fetch_pr_json inside itself, issuing a second identical pulls/n REST read. The first fetch result is discarded.
  WHY: No crash or correctness failure. Each merged-PR hit on the managed REST-fallback path consumes one redundant GitHub API call, which is unnecessary spend but not a correctness defect. The same class of issue was fixed for the issue JSON in round 1 finding 5 by passing _mgd_issue_json; the PR JSON was not covered.

The PR diff shows five poller paths now gated (reconcile loop, validation-dispatch wave gate, stall-recovery tag, backward-scan promotion, validation fix-up backfill), matching the plan's Goals. Every path the finding named is covered.
  severity=NIT | confidence=5
